response.name: debug_launch
response.description: Launch a local .NET Framework target. Copy the returned sessionId. Use stopAtEntry=true before setting initial breakpoints.

response.name: debug_attach
response.description: Attach to one local Desktop CLR process without terminating it on detach.

response.name: debug_set_breakpoint
response.description: Create a source breakpoint with file and line, or update enabled using only breakpointId and enabled. Report moved/pending states.

response.name: debug_remove_breakpoint
response.description: Remove a source breakpoint by its returned ID.

response.name: debug_continue
response.description: Resume exactly once; waitForStop=false returns an operationId to poll with debug_status. Old frame/reference IDs expire.

response.name: debug_step
response.description: Step one specified thread into/over/out. Requires a stopped session. Old frame/reference IDs expire.

response.name: debug_pause
response.description: Pause a running target and complete its active operation with userPause.

response.name: debug_status
response.description: Read session state, last stop, symbols/breakpoints and optionally an operation result; safe to poll while running.

response.name: debug_threads
response.description: Read managed threads from a stopped session; use returned IDs, never guess them.

response.name: debug_stack
response.description: Read managed frames for one stopped thread. Use returned opaque frameId for variables.

response.name: debug_variables
response.description: Read fields/arguments/locals without getters, ToString or evaluation. References belong to this session and stop only.

response.name: debug_detach
response.description: Safely detach and leave the target running. Ends the debugging session.

response.name: debug_terminate
response.description: Terminate only a target launched by this debugger. Attached targets are rejected.
